items.criterion: A wrong password issues no token.
items.judgment: Sign in with a wrong password and assert a refusal with no access token in the body.

items.criterion: A logged survey stores one open fault row per zone.
items.judgment: Log three zones and assert three open rows for the survey.

items.criterion: An invalid survey leaves no survey row.
items.judgment: Post a survey with no zone and assert no survey row carries its notes.

items.criterion: The queue orders faults by severity, deformation, flown-at.
items.judgment: Create faults spanning each tie-break and assert the listed order.

items.criterion: Simultaneous claims on one fault admit exactly one claimant.
items.judgment: Race claims from two engineers and assert one acceptance with a claimed status.

items.criterion: Simultaneous claims leave exactly one claimed history entry.
items.judgment: Race claims and count claimed rows in fault_events.

items.criterion: A second engineer confirming a held fault is denied.
items.judgment: Claim as one engineer, confirm as another, assert a denial with the fault still claimed.

items.criterion: A pilot claiming a fault is denied.
items.judgment: Claim from a pilot session and assert a denial with the fault still open.

items.criterion: A confirmed fault is stored confirmed and leaves the queue.
items.judgment: Claim and confirm, assert the stored status and absence from the queue.

items.criterion: Confirming sends exactly one email to the site owner.
items.judgment: Confirm a fault and assert one message addressed to the owner at the mail service.
Dismiss a fault, settle, assert no message to the owner.

items.criterion: The console reads as one calm operational tool across its screens.
items.judgment: A person opens the overview, the queue and a fault page and judges whether they share one ink, one type family and one top bar.

items.criterion: The worst fault is recognisable at a glance in the queue.
items.judgment: A person opens the queue and judges whether the top line's numeral and weight make its rank obvious.
